youtube.title: Why Microwaves Leave Cold Spots 🥶 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Ever microwaved food and it's boiling in one spot and frozen in another?

Microwaves bounce around inside the box and overlap. Where the waves stack up, food gets hot. Where they cancel out, almost nothing happens. That's why there's a turntable. It drags your food through the hot spots. Take the turntable out and microwave a bar of chocolate, and you'll see melted spots in a row. Measure the gap between them, and you can work out the speed of light.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.

#Shorts #howitworks #science #kitchen #thehiddenwhy
